card.name: Punctuation before dates and definitions
card.fires_on: Punctuation or a space right after a headword, pronunciation or date in encyclopedia-style entries, just before a year, population figure or definition begins. Also a few spots inside dates.

modes.label: After pronunciation guide
modes.description: A closing parenthesis and comma after a respelled pronunciation, before the definition starts.

modes.label: Before a year or figure
modes.description: An opening parenthesis, comma, or space just before a year or population number.

modes.label: Inside a date
modes.description: A comma or space in a written date, just before the year.

card.plain: It fires on the small punctuation mark that sits between an entry's name and the year or definition that follows.
